question: Estimate the revenue generated by IPL sponsorship and ads in a single season.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total IPL ecosystem revenue: title sponsor + central + team sponsorships + broadcaster ads + digital? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Team-level jersey + apparel sponsorships (10 teams): ~₹1,200 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total IPL season ad + sponsorship revenue: ~₹10,700-11,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total IPL season ad + sponsorship revenue

calculationFlow: Central sponsors (BCCI level — Dream11, My11Circle, Cred, Tata Motors, etc.): ~₹600-700 Cr.
Digital/OTT ad revenue (JioCinema/JioHotstar): ~₹4,500 Cr (peaked at ~$650M in 2024).
Team-level jersey + apparel sponsorships (10 teams): ~₹1,200 Cr.
On-ground branding (stadium ads, boundary boards): ~₹400 Cr.
Total IPL season ad + sponsorship revenue: ~₹10,700-11,000 Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total IPL season ad + sponsorship revenue: ~₹10,700-11,000 Cr.
